title: GrantThai writing intent (guidance/writing_intent.yaml)
description: Draft (v0.2). Per-field writing intent: purpose, micro-template, length target, keep-out list and quality traits, plus a completeness checklist. This is guidance for the person writing, never a validator of knowledge: length findings are REVIEW-level only and no entry here can move a status. Every Thai string is NEEDS_INPUT unless it carries a cited source (the only Thai text filled is practice advice, next to its corpus evidence). Every length_target.basis cites where the target comes from; a target with no readable source says so (proposed_default) and stays NEEDS_VERIFICATION.

th.description: NEEDS_INPUT until a Thai wording with a cited source exists (tests/test_writing_intent.py).

basis.description: Where the target or check comes from. Forms: 'core/0N §…' (handoff package; excluded from the public repo, so the reading is relayed and NEEDS_VERIFICATION), 'SD-n pX' (public document, PDF page), 'registry:<FIELD_ID> guidance' (registry/fields.jsonl guidance.en), 'docs/design/PLAN.md §…', or 'proposed_default …' (GrantThai's own default, INSTINCT, revisable through a reviewed PR).

seen_in.description: A real, publicly available funded report cited by id and PDF page only ('R1 p8'), never quoted text; or NEEDS_INPUT until a reader has recorded the page.

practice.description: Practice shared by funded final reports (docs/practice/funded-work-patterns.md, corpus of 100). Evidence, not a fund rule: it never moves a status. The tier and count must equal what tools/corpus/practice_stats.py computes from docs/demo/corpus-100.csv (tests/test_practice_patterns.py). The Thai advice is GrantThai's own practice wording (DRAFT), written next to its cited evidence; it is not a form label or a fund fact.

context.description: For CONTEXTUAL or EMERGING: where the pattern concentrates (source, discipline or period).

seen_in.description: Deep-read funded reports, by corpus id and PDF page only, never quoted text.

rule.description: The REVIEW rule that checks this CORE pattern, if any.

kind.description: Required when evaluable is deterministic. fields_filled: every listed field has a value (not NEEDS_INPUT). length_within: no listed field breaks its length_target. items_have_key: every item of the listed array fields has a non-empty params.key.
